purpose: Pre-register deterministic meteorological stratification before computing rankings or selecting any parallel window, without Cashahuacra magnitudes or territorial outcomes.

daily_features.definition: maximum rolling 3-hour IMERG depth within local calendar day D
IMERG total from local 00:00 through 24:00 on D
IMERG total during seven full local days ending at local 00:00 at start of D
daily_features.reason: antecedent wetness proxy without using outcome time

primary_selection.selection_rule: For each target, among still-unselected days with known composite score and anchor distance >=9 local calendar days from all already-selected anchors in the same track-season, choose the day whose composite percentile is closest to the target.
primary_selection.reason_for_separation: Nine-day D-7 through D+1 scientific windows must not overlap in the primary stratified cohort.

forbidden_post_hoc_actions: change feature set after inspecting selected dates
change percentile targets after inspecting selected dates
replace selected window because Sentinel-1 or Landsat is missing
replace selected window because territorial evidence is inconvenient
tune weights using Cashahuacra feature magnitudes
interpret score as risk or activation probability
